series.name: Construction Industry Forum
series.label: Construction Industry Forum
series.tagline: High-level dialogue and business networking for the Maldives construction industry.
description: The Construction Industry Forum is an annual gathering of decision makers from the government and private sectors of the building and construction industry.
Industry leaders and key stakeholders identify the fundamental issues facing the industry, present solutions and raise awareness, to shape where Maldivian construction goes next.
series.audience: Government and private-sector decision makers in building and construction

series.name: Maldives Marine Industry Forum
series.label: Marine Industry Forum
series.tagline: Where the Maldives marine industry meets to plan its future.
description: The Maldives Marine Industry Forum is an annual gathering of decision makers from the government and private sectors of the marine industry.
Industry leaders and key stakeholders identify the fundamental issues facing the marine industry, present solutions and raise awareness.
series.audience: Marine industry leaders from government and the private sector

series.name: Aviation Forum – Connecting Maldives
series.label: Aviation Forum
series.tagline: Reshaping the aviation industry of the Maldives through stakeholder dialogue.
description: The Aviation Forum brings together the Maldives' most influential aviation leaders, uniting senior government officials and private-sector pioneers.
Its purpose is practical: to agree actionable solutions and set the strategic direction of Maldivian aviation.
series.audience: Government officials and private-sector aviation leaders

series.name: Build Expo
series.label: Build Expo
series.tagline: The official exhibition of the Maldives National Association of Construction Industry.
description: Build Expo is a four-day exhibition at Central Park, Hulhumalé, with an exhibition and equipment display area, stage activities, networking sessions, product launches and entertainment.
It is a place to meet prospective customers and gain recognition across the construction industry.
series.audience: Contractors, suppliers, developers and the public
